assign.request: You are the spacing judge. Four auditors measured 92 pages at five widths; a manager ranked the results. Decide, write the decision down where a reader will find it, apply it, and keep the alternatives visible. Four rulings: (a) the spacing scale at 3440, (b) the few useful levels, (c) the control rule, (d) every discrepancy gets a reason or a fix. Brief: ai/2026-09-05/spacing-judge/requirements.md
assign.now: baseline shot at 1280 and 3440; reading the offenders
steps: Read the evidence: brief, ranked list, tokens, the offenders' rules
Shoot + measure BEFORE at 1280 and 3440 on five pages
Rule (a): the scale - framework.css tokens, Page.css column pads, the head/body seam
Rule (b): three spacing levels in the theme layer
Rule (c): the control rule applied to summary, preview/page/sidebar links, realm chips, D5
Shoot + measure AFTER; look; undo anything worse
Write decision.md, link it from the study, the ceilings paragraph

log.msg: BEFORE medians (px, sibling distance in .active-page) 1280 -> 3440: paging 5.25 -> 6.30; toolbars 6.02 -> 7.19; framework 9.02 -> 10.80; research 3.44 -> 4.13; home 9.02 -> 10.80. The 1.2x cluster, reproduced. No horizontal overflow anywhere.

assign.now: applied: ramps + levels in framework.css, column pads/seam/preview-link in Page.css, 8 control fixes; shooting AFTER

log.msg: Ruled (a): --pad-ramp clamp(1em, 2.6% - 1.1em, 4em) 16.5 -> 70px full-width; --gap-ramp clamp(1em, 1.5vw - 0.3em, 2.6em) 15 -> 46px; --flow-ramp clamp(2em, 1.4vw + 0.8em, 3em) 30 -> 54px (cap 3em: a paragraph gap past two lines reads as a section break); column pad-x/pad-y confirmed (already 3.2x / 2.4x), column prose --flow clamp(0.8em, 0.8cqi, 1.6em) 10.8 -> 25px. All floors hold 1280 to the pixel. (b): spacing-tight .6 / regular 1 / spacing-airy 1.6 on one token --spacing, defaults re-derived on :where(*) because a custom property substitutes var() where declared. (c): a control hugs (fit-content, 0.6-1em side pad); inline text links are not controls (U2); rows of one list may touch and span (U3). Applied to summary, page-preview-link, decks-chip, codrops-link, codrops-demo-title, research-card-name; reasoned exceptions on page-link, sidebar-link, yt-start, D5 slides/covers.

AFTER, same five pages: medians UNCHANGED at both widths (paging 5.25/6.30, toolbars 6.02/7.19, framework 9.02/10.80, research 3.44/4.13, home 9.02/10.80) - the median sibling distance on these pages is a card-internal or rail-row gap (0.35-0.8em constants in research.css, paging cards, sidebar rows) that never read the tokens. What moved is the third quartile at 3440: framework 24.4 -> 46.2px, research 23.7 -> 42.1px; and every control: summary 720/69 -> 86/69 on /framework/, 2404/485 -> 518/485 on /imagine/research/; page-preview-link 241/94 -> 94/94; paging stage inset 36 -> 54px (toolbars: 54 + 51 = 105px before content); decks-chip 700-wide cells -> 92/55 hugging; codrops-link 721/59 -> 79/79. 1280: unchanged to the pixel except research p75 13.5 -> 15.1 (the D6 seam, a rail's first row one pad-y under the head). No horizontal overflow on any page or width. Levels side by side at 3440: pad 32 / 54 / 86px, flow 32 / 54 / 86px, gap 28 / 46 / 74px - visibly three steps (levels-3440.jpg). Side effect kept, not undone: the paging rail's nav grids read the page gap and went one column at 3440 - that rail is what spacing-tight is for, and it is the paging agent's fence.

assign.now: docs: readme pointers, skill improvements, clean-load check

assign.outcome:
**Three ramps, three levels, one control rule — decided, applied in `framework.css` + `Page.css`, verified by eye at 1280 and 3440.** `--pad-ramp` / `--gap-ramp` / `--flow-ramp` hold their 1280 floors to the pixel and read 70 / 46 / 54px at 3440 (were 36 / 24 / 36); `spacing-tight` · regular · `spacing-airy` = 0.6 / 1 / 1.6 on one token, `--spacing`, re-derived on every element; a control hugs (`summary`, the preview card's title link, `decks-chip`, the codrops links, the research card name), a row spans (sidebar and column rows), an inline text link is not a control — which retires 4,419 of the 9,177 findings (U2). D1–D7 and U1–U9 each have a fix or a reason in the decision. Medians on the five re-measured pages did not move (they are card-internal constants that never read the tokens); the third quartile at 3440 did (24 → 46px on /framework/, 24 → 42px on /imagine/research/) and every named strip is gone (summary 720/69 → 86/69; research 2,404 → 518; decks chips 700px cells → 92/55). Nothing crosses the 1280 fold, nothing overflows.

![](levels-3440.jpg)

Left, each with its reason in the decision: the column-prose vs inner-`.md` rhythm at 1280 (closing it would tighten prose); `spacing-tight` on the sidebar (changes 1280) and on the paging rail — its nav grids read the page gap and went one column at 3440, the paging agent's fence; a live levels demo page (fence); U7, the 40em measure question.
